eligibility: Must be 18 years of age or older by Dec. 7, 2026
Must be available for a full-time internship (30 hours per week)
Must have 42 consecutive days free from school and exams during the internship period (for students)
Your visa must allow you to work 30 hours per week
cannot_apply_if: You cannot apply if you are a past Outreachy intern.
You cannot apply if you are a past Outreach Program for Women intern.
You cannot apply if you are a past Google Summer of Code intern.
You cannot apply if you have another internship during the Outreachy internship period.
You cannot apply if you have a full-time job during the Outreachy internship period.
You cannot apply if you have a full-time contracting position during the Outreachy internship period.
You cannot apply if you are on a leave of absence from a full-time job during the Outreachy internship period.
You cannot apply if your visa does not allow you to work 30 hours per week.
You cannot apply if you are completing your last term for your degree and your school is located in the hemisphere where the internship cohort is offered.
prepare: Have a calendar for online courses (online courses)
Have a calendar for coding school (coding school)
Have the average number of invoiced hours over the past six months (self-employed contractor)
Write answers to five essay questions (essays)
Applicants are required to list their current internships on their initial application.
Applicants are required to list their current jobs on their initial application.
typical_timing: Initial applications open: early February for the May-Aug round, late August for the Dec-Mar round
Initial applications due: end of February for the May-Aug round, early September for the Dec-Mar round
Contribution period opens: mid March for the May-Aug round, early October for the Dec-Mar round
Contribution period ends: mid April for the May-Aug round, end of October for the Dec-Mar round
Interns announced: mid May for the May-Aug round, late November for the Dec-Mar round
note: The current round is closed to new applicants. Any dates listed are only for people already approved.
